subject.size_in_frame: three-quarter figure, about 0.70 of frame height, arm fully extended across the frame

second_subject.note: held at the far end of her straight arm, turning; about 0.14 of frame height.

headroom: about 0.16 of frame height, matched to sh044 so the two frames from this set-up sit together.
horizon_eyeline: Eye-level at 1.3 m from beside the glass table: dado level behind her at 0.60 of frame height. Her eyeline is at 0.42 and runs straight along her own outstretched arm to the bottle — the eyeline and the arm are the same line.

layers.fg: the near edge of the glass tabletop crossing the bottom left corner
layers.mg: Alice with the bottle held out at full stretch, prim and careful
layers.bg: the low curtain and the locked doors of the west wall, dark

gaze.note: she looks along her arm to frame right at the thing she is holding away from herself; the lead room is occupied by the bottle at arm's length. A well-brought-up child putting the maximum available distance between her face and an unlabelled substance.

balance: A long horizontal figure spanning nearly the whole frame width, weighted at both ends — head left, bottle right — with nothing in the middle but a straight arm. The carefulness is a shape, not an expression.
leading_lines: Her arm is the single dominant horizontal, running from the left third to the right third at just above mid-frame; the dado behind runs parallel to it and slightly lower, doubling the gesture.
eye_first: Her face, then straight along the arm to the bottle, and back.
constraint_binding: Comedy of manners — the whole joke is carried by the extension of the arm inside a static frame, so the bottle stays inside action-safe at the end of the stretch and the frame is wide enough that her hand never approaches the right edge. No reframe and no insert: she checks the rules in one picture.
